requirements.evidence: No part with that id exists in catalog (find_parts for turbo and drawer returned zero/turbo matches, only generic notch drawer frames found). Closest available drawer frame installed: notch:0#-1,-1#notch5 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) between bases piece:0,0,0;half-e and piece:1,-1,0;half-w with supporting full bases, but not the requested turbo-drawer-9000.

finish.summary: Built a base assembly with the closest available drawer (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm at -1,-1) on a half-e base. The requested hex-turbo-drawer-9000 does not exist in the catalog and could not be placed.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
